report_title: FY2026 Result and FY2027 Guidance (9 Jul 2026, web-derived)
notes: MD Paul Cmrlec. Norseman is 100%-owned (JV with Tulla Resources restructured 2023-24). FY26 was challenging: UG production fell short on WA labour shortages, contractor delivery issues (OK mine contractor changed to Redpath Australia), and seismic activity in deeper OK levels. FY27 guidance 90,000-105,000 oz. Debt free, unhedged; on-market share buyback announced Feb 2026; A$216.5M cash & gold at Dec 2025. Partnership with Mega Resources for Rama open pit. Full-year FY26 AISC/cash cost not disclosed in extraction sources (Q2 FY26 AISC was A$2,571/oz; quarterly C1 cash costs ranged A$1,962-2,493/oz). Norseman Ore Reserve (Sep 2025 statement) not captured in extraction sources.

mines.processing: Norseman plant (~1.1 Mt processed FY26, ~95% recovery)
mines.mine_notes: 100% owned (Pantoro operates). Mines: OK UG, Scotia UG, Princess Royal OP, Gladstone OP. Quarterly head grades 2.21-2.68 g/t (FY26). Q4 FY26: 18,028 oz. Underground development at Scotia Mainfield; OK Main Lode development commenced. Full-year AISC not disclosed; converted figure not shown to avoid estimate.
